Very disappointing visit to a highly rated fine dining restaurant!
Jan 2024 • Couples
While we loved the hotel, we are very sorry to say that our restaurant experience was very disappointing and underwhelming, which concerns us given the stellar reviews. The food quality and presentation was severely lacking, which made us think that the chef was on a day off and didn’t leave adequate instructions to his kitchen staff. The food simply did not live up to the required standards of a fine dining restaurant. I really hope they can sort this out, because the location and outlook is second to none!
Written January 11, 2024

Nov 2023 • Friends
The food that we ordered as a party of 6 was cooked to perfection, with some lovely touches. 
The staff here are exceptional, well trained with an eye for detail. They were also very helpful and knowledgeable about the dishes, which made the choice so much easier. 
Being low season, the restaurant was quiet, but we made our own entertainment, so as a couple it might lack atmosphere at this time of year. Saying that, the staff make up for it.

Exceptional dining on the banks of the Perfume River
Apr 2023 • Friends
We went to Le Parfum for the Degustation Experience which had been highly recommended to us . With good reason. It was really beautiful . Seven delicious , perfectly balanced courses beautifully presented. The service was impeccable . Wine list was quite limited but adequate-only two Aussie and two NZ wines on offer. We decided on a French Chardonnay and a Syrah which complemented the food perfectly. The wine however was very expensive. This seems to be a common theme in Vietnam with very little Aussie wine on offer and we have had numerous discussions about how to remedy this. All in all a really top quality offering.

Beautiful Food, Outstanding Staff
Mar 2020
I recently spent a night at the La Residence and enjoyed all of the meals at Le Parfum. The food was excellent! Too often, restaurants pile on mediocre food - not at Le Parfum, portion sizes were perfect. While I enjoyed the hotel and the food, what I really want to do is give a shout-out to Lien. She was an excellent server and bartender... personable and friendly and more than willing to answer my questions about living in Hue. Her warmth made my stay just that much more special.
